title: Hidden Canyon Kayak
specs: Guided tours of iconic Upper and Lower Antelope Canyon with Navajo guides
Kayak tours include paddling below massive cliffs and hiking slot canyons only accessible by water
Lower Antelope Canyon tour: ages 4 and older for adult ticket, infants 0-3 years old
Upper Antelope Canyon tour: ages 8 and older for adult ticket, infants 0-7 years old
Guests must be able to walk several flights of narrow stairs with handrails
Not allowed: pregnant guests, pets or animals, guests not physically capable of hiking
Antelope Canyon tours require arrival 30 minutes prior to tour time
Water taxi maximum group size is 6, may be less depending on taxi size

blurb: Guests can explore Upper and Lower Antelope Canyon with guided hiking tours led by Navajo guides. Kayak rentals are available for self-guided adventures on Lake Powell and Antelope Canyon. The tours include hiking through slot canyons and kayaking on the Colorado River channel near Antelope Island.
